title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Free, under-21-friendly things to do on or near NDSU, using publicly documented no-admission options.

cards.title: See the Memorial Union Gallery exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, 1401 Administration Ave., Fargo
cards.notes: Head to the second floor during the semester to view the current exhibition; check the gallery schedule before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A campus art stop with rotating work by students and visiting artists.
cards.evidence_claim: NDSU says the Memorial Union Gallery hosts exhibitions and that all gallery events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Second floor of the Memorial Union; the gallery lists semester hours as Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m., or by appointment.

cards.title: Browse Color Improvisations 3
cards.subtitle: William and Anna Jane Schlossman Gallery, downtown Fargo
cards.notes: Use the current exhibition page to confirm dates, then take a self-guided look at the quilts and their color studies.
cards.short_summary: A free downtown gallery visit centered on contemporary textile art.
cards.evidence_claim: Plains Art Museum states that gallery admission is free every day and lists Color Improvisations 3 through August 23, 2026.
cards.access_notes: The exhibition is at Plains Art Museum's William and Anna Jane Schlossman Gallery; confirm museum visiting hours before going.

cards.title: Use the Dike East winter trail
cards.subtitle: Cross-country ski and snowshoe trail near downtown Fargo
cards.notes: Bring or borrow suitable gear and use the groomed route when conditions allow; trail grooming depends on weather and need.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront winter outing with a publicly listed free trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Fargo Park District lists Dike East Park & Dog Park among its cross-country ski and snowshoe trail locations and says the trails are available to the public free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Trails are groomed as needed depending on weather; no trail admission is charged.

cards.title: Take a Forest River Park snowshoe loop

cards.notes: Choose this park for a low-key winter meet-up, and check conditions first because grooming is performed only as needed.
cards.short_summary: A named Fargo Park District winter-trail location with no public trail charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Fargo Park District lists Forest River Park as a cross-country ski and snowshoe trail location and says these trails are available to the public free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Bring your own or borrowed equipment; weather and grooming determine trail conditions.
